messages.author: df9ba0266a9a081f
messages.subject: MSstats 2.1.3 released!!
parts:
MSstats 2.1.3 is released on msstats.org

The main updates are
- Fix the groupComparison function for label-free experiments (Thanks to Olga)
- add more Normalization option in dataProcess function : quantile normalization and normalization with standard proteins.
- add progress messages in groupComparison, dataProcessPlots.
- add more error messages in order to give the idea where the problem happens.

Please let me know if you have any difficulty and bugs.

Happy new year!!

messages.author: 701dadf5d5bd3f3b
messages.subject: Re: MSstats 2.1.3 released!!
parts:
Dear Steve,

Not in an immediate future, unfortunately. This is because the structure of the data in MS2 quantification differs from that in MS1 or SRM quantification, and the models that we use cannot be applied directly. The general framework is applicable, though, and we plan to extend these models in the future (possibly in the second half of 2014)

Sincerely
Olga

messages.author: 701dadf5d5bd3f3b
messages.subject: Re: MSstats 2.1.3 released!!
parts:
Hi Steve,

This is correct. The difference for iTRAQ is that the measurements are grouped at the MS2 level, and there is a random number of MS2 spectra in each run. This difference in groupings affects the standard errors. So a linear mixed model would apply, but not in a default MSstats implementation. Here are a couple of references that can be of interest
http://www.biomedcentral.com/1471-2105/13/S16/S7
http://pubs.acs.org/doi/abs/10.1021/pr300624g 

Sincerely
Olga
